name: simota-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods: agent pane, quality gate, sandbox denial report, TODO(agent) list, compact tool rows, image preview, quick actions, self-audit, browser cam, prompt coach, loopback, error book, pull request lamp, exploration map, assertion guard, negative-space tests, mutation tap, perf delta, port lantern, artifact shelf, focus HUD, side-effect ledger, visual diff, journey trace, token lens, hit rate, earned-green click

plugins.name: agent-pane
plugins.description: Live pane of the session's subagents: running ones with elapsed time, finished ones with result and duration

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Flags unverified edits, stops repeated failing commands, and blocks git --no-verify

plugins.name: sandbox-lens
plugins.description: Tallies sandbox denials seen in Bash output and reports them with /sandbox-report

plugins.name: todo-agent
plugins.description: Collects #TODO(agent) follow-ups from Claude's replies into a per-project list with a /todos pane.

plugins.name: tool-row
plugins.description: Redraws finished tool-call rows in the terminal as one compact line with a Nerd Font icon, Gruvbox colors and a short stat

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Thumbnails of the images a session writes, reads or generates: under the tool's row in the terminal, and in an /images pane

plugins.name: self-audit
plugins.description: After each turn, a cached fork of the conversation audits Claude's own reply against the CLAUDE.md reporting rules and flags violations above the prompt

plugins.name: browser-cam
plugins.description: Live pane of the browser Claude drives: the latest screenshot from Claude in Chrome, the page URL and the recent actions

plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: Holds back a typed prompt that looks ambiguous (no done-condition, unclear target) and offers to send it as is or add one; on by default

plugins.name: loopback
plugins.description: Feeds what self-audit, done-gate and sandbox-lens found back to Claude beside the next prompt, instead of only showing it to the person, skipping rules hit-rate found mostly wrong; off by default

plugins.name: zukan
plugins.description: Error book: catches the errors Bash commands hit across sessions and repos, records what got past each one, and when one comes back tells Claude and the person how it was fixed last time

plugins.name: pr-lamp
plugins.description: The current branch's pull request as a lamp: checks, review, unresolved threads and what is left before a merge, in the status line and a /pr pane; red checks and new review comments fed to Claude beside the next prompt

plugins.name: fog-map
plugins.description: Exploration map: the repository as a tree under fog, cleared where Claude read, marked where it edited, made a file or hit an error, with the importers an edit may have broken unseen; /map

plugins.name: assertion-guard
plugins.description: Catches edits that weaken tests to make them pass: assertions removed, expectations loosened or rewritten, tests skipped, exceptions swallowed; asks Claude for the reason beside the tool's result and keeps a band until the person has checked it

plugins.name: negative-space
plugins.description: When an edit adds authorization, input validation or error handling, lists the refusal, invalid-input, failure and boundary-value tests that no test touched this session covers yet; a band after the turn and /negative-space

plugins.name: mutation-tap
plugins.description: /mutate runs a mutation test limited to the lines changed since HEAD: each small change to the code (a flipped comparison, && for ||, a constant) is run against the tests, and the ones the tests did not catch are listed

plugins.name: perf-delta
plugins.description: /perf runs a benchmark command several times and compares it with its baseline (saved earlier, or a git ref run in a temporary worktree): median wall time, peak memory and the spread of the runs, and whether the difference is larger than the noise

plugins.name: port-lantern
plugins.description: Keeps track of the dev servers the session started: their URLs and ports from the server's own output, whether each still listens, and its latest log lines, in the status line and a /ports pane; a toast when one starts or stops

plugins.name: artifact-shelf
plugins.description: A shelf of what the sessions made: CSV, PDF, HTML, video, audio, images, patches and archives, each tied to the call that made it and the request it answered; /shelf finds them by kind, word, place or time

plugins.name: focus-hud
plugins.description: One status line that says what is going on: the goal (the request, or the todo in progress), the target (the file, page or command in hand), what is running and for how long, and what it waits on (you, a permission, an answer, a tool); /focus gives the detail

plugins.name: side-effect-ledger
plugins.description: A ledger of what a git diff never shows: pushes, publishes, deploys, pull requests, releases, API writes and messages sent, each with its outcome, how it would be undone, and whether that undo has been checked; /ledger

plugins.name: visual-diff
plugins.description: Compares the browser screenshots Claude takes of the same URL at the same size, before and after an edit: both side by side, a map of the cells that changed, the changed regions in page pixels and the files edited in between; /vdiff

plugins.name: journey-trace
plugins.description: Records what Claude does in the browser (pages opened, clicks, typing, keys, form fills) and the states expected along the way as a recipe to replay; /journey turns it into a bug report's steps in Markdown or a Playwright test draft

plugins.name: token-lens
plugins.description: Checks a page element's actual colours, spacing and type against the project's registered design tokens (CSS custom properties, SCSS variables, tokens JSON): /token-lens <selector>, or the text selected in the browser, lists each value as a token or an off-token value with the nearest token

plugins.name: hit-rate
plugins.description: Gives each finding of done-gate, assertion-guard, self-audit and zukan a later verdict from what the session did next (a failing check, a reverted edit, a rule not repeated, a recalled fix reused), keeps each rule's precision across sessions, and names the rules loopback stops feeding; /hit-rate; off by default

plugins.name: kachi
plugins.description: When a check you broke turns green after a real fix, the band above the prompt sweeps green once with a short click, and the result row keeps the score; silent the rest of the time but for one dim line on a check's first red
